title: Dynamic Lora Loading
definition: The capability of a large language model to adapt to different tasks using dynamic loading of LoRA.

difficulty_levels.beginner: A feature that allows a large language model to adapt to new tasks using specialized modules.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: A technique for a large language model to learn new tasks by dynamically loading additional layers known as LoRA.
difficulty_levels.expert: A method for a large language model to adapt to various tasks by selectively loading or removing LoRA (Layer-wise Relevance Adaption) layers.

extra_fields.insight: A mechanism that enables a large language model to perform various tasks without the need for retraining.
